skill.summary: Free daily growth assistant for online businesses. Track basic revenue metrics, get daily action priorities, and monitor progress toward goals.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Revenue Agent Lite.
- Track basic revenue metrics for your online business.
- Get daily growth action priorities tailored to your current numbers and goals.
- Visualize progress toward monthly or quarterly revenue targets.
- Free version limited to a single revenue source with manual data input.
